content.title: Speaking Test 11 — Sport
content.description: The full three-part interview: sport and exercise in Part 1, a long turn on “Describe an outdoor activity you tried for the first time”, then a discussion of sport and young people and professional sport.

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's talk about sport and exercise.

Do you play any sports? [Why/Why not?]
How much exercise do you get in a typical week? [Why?]
Did you enjoy sport when you were at school? [Why/Why not?]
Do you prefer watching sport or taking part in it? [Why?]
Describe an outdoor activity you tried for the first time.
bulletsHtml: where and when you tried it
and explain how you felt about trying it

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's consider sport and young people.

Why do some young people stop doing sport when they leave school?
Is it schools or parents who should encourage children to be active?
Do you think competitive sport is good for children?

Let's consider professional sport.

Why are professional sportspeople paid so much in some countries?
Do you think sports stars have a duty to behave well in public?
Should governments spend public money on hosting major sporting events?
